# Pure Marketing

> Pure Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. We help local service businesses — electricians, plumbers, HVAC companies, landscapers, roofers, and more — get consistent, qualified leads through Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, web design, social media management, and video production. No long-term contracts. Free strategy calls available.

- Name: Pure Marketing

## Services

- [Lead Generation](https://puremarketing.ca/services/lead-generation): Done-for-you lead generation using Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Local Service Ads. Clients average 40-80 qualified leads per month. No long-term contracts. Fully managed campaigns with transparent reporting. From $1,499/month.
- [Google and Meta Ads](https://puremarketing.ca/services/google-meta-ads): Expert pay-per-click advertising management on Google and Facebook/Instagram. Average return on ad spend: 5-8x. Includes campaign setup, creative, optimization, and monthly reporting. From $500/month.
- [Web Design and Development](https://puremarketing.ca/services/web-development): Conversion-optimized custom websites for local service businesses. Mobile-first, fast-loading, designed to turn visitors into booked calls and form submissions. Custom quoted.
- [Social Media Management](https://puremarketing.ca/services/social-media-management): Full social media management on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Includes content creation, daily posting, engagement management, and growth strategy. From $899/month.
- [Video Production](https://puremarketing.ca/services/video-production): Professional video content for local businesses including social media reels, brand story videos, customer testimonials, and property tours. From $699/project.
- Local SEO: Search engine optimization to help local businesses rank higher on Google Maps and local organic search results. Includes Google Business Profile optimization, citation building, and on-page SEO.

## FAQ

Q: What is Pure Marketing?
A: Pure Marketing is a Hamilton, Ontario digital marketing agency that specializes in helping local service businesses get more qualified leads. They offer lead generation, Google Ads, Meta Ads, web design, social media management, and video production.

Q: How much does Pure Marketing cost?
A: Lead generation from $1,499/month. Google Ads and Meta Ads from $500/month. Social media management from $899/month. Video production from $699/project. Web design is custom-quoted. All month-to-month, no contracts.

Q: Does Pure Marketing require contracts?
A: No. Month-to-month with no long-term contracts. Cancel any time.

Q: Where is Pure Marketing located?
A: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Serves clients across the GTA, Ontario, Canada, and the United States remotely.

Q: How do I book a consultation?
A: Book a free 30-minute strategy call at https://puremarketing.ca. Email info@puremarketing.ca or call +1 647-951-2786. Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 8 PM EST.

Q: What industries does Pure Marketing specialize in?
A: Local service businesses: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, landscapers, roofers, general contractors, painters, real estate agents, restaurants, and cleaning services.

Q: How quickly can Pure Marketing generate leads?
A: Most clients see qualified leads within 7-14 days. Full optimization in 30-60 days.
